items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Willie Manning says, Jacques, Duke wants to see you... Willie Manning went and told Duke that I don't want to be bothered with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, a fellow named Al Martin. They had gotten this thing down right on Broadway, The Ebony Club. So, I looked at everybody, and at that time, because I had to go back to work, I had about a month or something like that as part of my contract so, I visit everybody, saw everybody and then at that time, Willie Manning says, Jacques, Duke wants to see you, he wants you to get in his band.
I says well, I'm sorry, Willie because I got a contract to go back to Europe and I won't be able to make this one.
